title: Permissions, Roles, App Context, and Administrative Scope
objectives: Permissions, Roles, App Context, and Administrative Scope
Verify the active operational state and explain the evidence.

tasks.instruction: On standalone idx01, compare admin and analyst in Settings → Indexes. Try creating application_logs as analyst, then create it as admin. Practice principals are local role simulations, not real authentication.

Inspect authorize.conf on sh01. Add application_logs to role_user srchIndexesAllowed and restart sh01. Preserve least privilege: do not grant indexes_edit to role_user. Verify the allowed index through the simulated analyst catalog/REST.
Explain the administrative capability and whether index definitions use global or per-app configuration context.

hints: Inspect effective configuration and the delivery error before changing a setting.
Creating an index does not add events. Verify the destination, activation and search window independently.

checks.label: application_logs is active on idx01 with the required settings
checks.name: application_logs

checks.label: Analyst can search the assigned index

questions.prompt: Do index definitions use global or per-app configuration context?

feedback.success: Completion requires active configuration, verified search results and correct evidence answers.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect failed outcomes. Disk changes require activation; data must be ingested explicitly.
